newsitem.title: USA: CCF Holding stock buyback approved.
newsitem.headline: CCF Holding stock buyback approved.

text.p: CCF Holding Co, the holding company of Clayton County Federal Savings and Loan Association, said on Monday that it had received regulatory authorization to repurchase up to 101,766 shares of its common stock.

The company said in a statement that the board of directors had approved the repurchase of up to 10 percent of its 1.02 million outstanding shares of common stock. However, CCF had been awaiting regulatory authorization to start the repurchase program.
The program follows the repurchase of 59,512 shares of common stock during the first year following the conversion and 113,073 shares, thus far, during the second year following conversion.

The repurchases will be made in open-market transactions, subject to the availability of stock. Repurchased shares will become authorized, but unissued shares may be utilized for general corporate and other purposes, including the issuances of shares in connection with the exercise of stock options.
